name: bld3_dvd_fibsum_of_pisano_dvd
statement: (m : ℕ) (h : p3_pisano m ∣ m) : m ∣ p3_fibsum m
closed: ∀ (m : ℕ) (h : p3_pisano m ∣ m), m ∣ p3_fibsum m
informal: Uses Mathlib2.p3_prop1 and Mathlib2.bld2_pisano_fib_odd_eq: if p3_pisano m = 0 then m = 0 and p3_fibsum 0 = 0; otherwise m is a multiple of a period (aux1), so fib (m + 2) ≡ fib 2 = 1 mod m and p3_fibsum m = fib (m + 2) - 1 ≡ 0.
type: ∀ (m : ℕ), Mathlib2.p3_pisano m ∣ m → m ∣ Mathlib2.p3_fibsum m
